decoded_option_strings.source: Huffman text bank, decompressed at runtime and captured by write watchpoint.
decoded_option_strings.supersedes: The earlier note that read all five of these as one undifferentiated cycle. Deathmatch and Capture are the match types; the other three are separate.
decoded_option_strings.verified: 2026-08-29: all eight re-found in the fully decoded bank (config/strings.json, 1333 strings) rather than resting on the runtime write-watchpoint capture they came from. The ids are new - the capture recorded text only.

also_in_the_same_block.note: Strings the watchpoint never caught because nothing wrote them while it was armed. The match-option block is 0x294..0x2A9 and these are the rest of it.
also_in_the_same_block.0x299: Time: @2 sec   <- a SECOND time template, minutes was not the only one

decoded_option_strings.arenas_are_level_names: 0x0CD and 0x0CE are not option strings: they sit inside the LEVEL NAME block 0x0C9..0x0D5, beside 'Blockade Runner 1' and 'Cantina Arena Lobby' (0x0D2). Listing them under decoded option strings blurred that - the option UI shows a level name, it does not own one.
